xwalk_note: OF 7118 class Ap: Sand and minor silt: exposed or water-saturated; alluvial terraces, plains, deltas and fans; eolian veneers and dunes; intertidal flats
OF 7118 class Mg: Silt and clay: exposed thick marine or glaciolacustrine deposits with gullied slopes
OF 7118 class Ms_1: Silt, clay and fine sand: grass-covered; thick marine or glaciolacustrine deposits
OF 7118 class Ms_2: Fine sand and silt: grass- and lichen-covered; locally wave-washed; marine or glaciolacustrine deposits (Ms2 + SG2)
OF 7118 class O: Organics: saturated, poorly drained; shallow sedge fens and sphagnum bogs
OF 7118 class SG_1: Sand and gravel: mainly grass- and/or lichen-covered; beaches, deltas, eskers, outwash terraces, ice-contact glaciofluvial deposits
OF 7118 class Tb_1: Non-bouldery till: silty-sand diamicton; thick deposits, grass- and lichen-covered; blanket and streamlined till
OF 7118 class Tb_2: Bouldery till: silty-sand to sandy diamicton; thick streamlined till and till blankets with abundant lichen-covered boulders
OF 7118 class B: Boulders: exposed and lichen-covered felsenmeer and boulder fields
OF 7118 class Ct: Carbonate-rich till: sandy-silt matrix-rich calcareous diamicton; solifluction stripes common
OF 7118 class R1: Undifferentiated bedrock: exposed outcrop; sporadic boulders
OF 7118 class R2: Undifferentiated bedrock: lichen-covered outcrop and felsenmeer; patches of boulders and thin drift cover
